To
All Regional PF Commissioners,
In-Charge of Regional/Sub Regional Offices.

Subject : Instructions for generating reports for levy of penal damages
under Section 14B and interest under Section 7Q of the EPF &
MP Act, 1952.

Dear Sir,

A report function for levy of Penal Damages and for informing the amount of
payable interest against an establishment has been provided in the new application
software in accordance with Section 14B of the Act read with Para 32A of EPF
Scheme, 1952 and Section 7Q of the Act.

2. The business logic behind the development of the software is as under. There
may be three possible scenarios of Contribution Due and the Belated Payments
made, requiring different treatment under the Act :

a) Scenario-I : Contribution Due before 26.09.2008(C1)
and Belated Payments made before
26,09,2008 (P1) ;

b) Scenario-II_ : Contribution Due after 26.09.2008(C2)
and Belated Payments made after
26.09.2008(P2);

c) Scenario-III_ : Contribution Due prior to 26.09.2008(C1)
but Belated Payments made on/after
26.09.2008(P2).

3. The combination of Contributions Due and Belated Payments made before
and after 26.09.2008 gives rise to the following rates of Penal Damages applicable
to each combination : y

—

a) Ci+P1 : Pre-Revised Rates of Penal Damages
b) C2+P2  : Revised Rates of Penal Damages

c) C1+P2 : Pre-Revised Rates on C1(i.e. Contributions Due
before 26.09.2008) and at Revised Rates on
C2(i.e. Contributions Due after 26.09.2008)

4. The same has been deployed through the application war version 4.22 on
03.10.2013.The reports can be generated from two different modules as detailed
below :

i) Establishment Module> Reports (for migrated and new Challan)
ii) Data Migration Module >> Reports (for legacy - Challan not migrated)
From the Establishment Module, the following reports can be generated:

a) List of establishments against which penal damages is to be
levied :

> This report gives a list of such establishments against which penal
damages are to be levied. Such establishments are also required to
pay the interest under Section 7Q of the Act.

>» There is a option in this module for the users to generate the report
for Establishments under each Enforcement Group and for a
particular period.

> In case the “All” is selected the report will be generated for all Challans
having presentation date from 01.04.1996 to the system date.

> The report can be generated for any selected period but not prior to
01.04.1996.

> The report can be generated for a range of probable damages and
amount of interest.

> After generating the list for all the Enforcement Groups and ranges,
the data shall be verified from the respective penal damages file to
check the period till which the damages are already levied / notices
already issued so that another notice is not issued for the same period
again.

5.

b

~~

Notice and calculation sheet for levy of damages :

Once the list of probable cases is generated, notices for the
establishments can be generated through this function.

There is a option in this module for the users to generate the notice for
a selected period or from 01.04.1996 to the system date.

It is advisable to generate the notice only till the period upto which the
Chalian Vs Bank Statement have been reconciled.

The notice has been designed as summons for the employer giving
him / her an opportunity to appear on the date of hearing and a
calculation sheet is printed as an annexure. The letter also intimates
the amount of interest under Section 7Q of the Act.

The notices are generated based on the reconciled challans only and
only when the date of presentation is available in the data base. An
annexure is also printed along with the notice (not for dispatch to the
establishment, showing the challans that are not reconciled and/or
challans having incomplete data on presentation date/wage month).
This annexure will help the office in knowing the cases where after
rectification/reconciliation the notices are to be issued.

In the cases pertaining to Pre - ECR period i.e prior to 01.04.2012
where payments for multiple due months have been remitted by the
establishment in a single Challan, the due month and the damages and
interest thereon is to be calculated manually.

Details of remittance of penal damages and interest under
Section 7Q:

This is a report on establishment wise details of remittance of penal
damages and / or interest under Section 7Q and can be generated for
a single establishment or for all establishment under any selected
Enforcement Group.

There is a option for selecting the period.

This report has the details of the remittances against each such
Challan and the Challan reference number. It helps in tracking the
penal damages and interest remittance and the print of the report can
be placed in the penal damages file as a proof.

From the Data Migration Module the following report is generated.

In case an office has not levied the damages for any Challan prior to
computerization and the Challans were not migrated as accounts were
already updated in the legacy, all the reports, for the penal damages
against the belated Challans that we represented on or after
01.04.1996, can be generated from this module.

Under this function only those Challans are considered that are not
migrated in the new application.

Care must be taken to check such cases before the issue of any notice
as there is no reconciliation detail against the bank statement in the
legacy Challan database.

However, to cover the cases of any Challan prior to presentation date
01.04.1996, the office has to handle such cases manually.

Accordingly, all Regional Provident Fund Commissioners, In-Charge of
Regional Offices / Sub-Regional Offices are requested to make use of the above
facility and to ensure that the damages and interest in all applicable cases upto
31.12.2013 are levied by 31.03.2014. In case where the probable damages and
interest amount exceeds rupees one lakh, all such notices shall be issued by
